How to play

Swap two neighbouring stickers on the same face. Tap one, then tap the other. Only swaps that make a match stick.

Match 3+ in a row or column. Lines can wrap around an edge onto the next face!

Turn the cube: drag anywhere, on the cube or around it. The cube follows your finger and snaps to the nearest quarter turn; a quick flick turns it a quarter. Left/right spins it around the vertical axis, up/down tips the face under your finger (left side = front face, right side = right face). The ◀ ▲ ▼ ▶ buttons and arrow keys turn it too. Turning is free and never costs a move. Pinch or use the mouse wheel to zoom, and ⟲ View resets the zoom.

After a match the stickers explode, new ones drop in, and that colour's rule fires: a real puzzle-cube slice twist relative to how you're looking at the cube. Matches made by refills or twists are combos and multiply your points. Tap during a long cascade to fast-forward it.

Power pieces: match 4 in a line for a ⚡ Line Blaster (clears its whole ring of 12 around the cube, in the direction of its stripes). Match an L or T shape for a 💣 Bomb (clears a 3×3 area, even across edges). Match 5 in a line for a 🌈 Rainbow Cube: swap it with any sticker to clear every sticker of that colour. Swap two power pieces together for huge combos!

Stones break when you match next to them. Hard stones take 2 hits. Locked stickers can't be swapped; match them to break the lock.

Stars: finishing a level gives 1★. Score past the ★ marks for 2★ and 3★. Every move you have left is worth bonus points.
